- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; reduce forecast peak values by 5–15% for immediate follow-up days.
- Underestimate prices during prolonged downward trends; adjust downward bias by 3–8% for 3–7 day horizons.
- Model tends to overreact to short-term volatility; dampen forecast momentum after sharp moves.
- Mean reversion bias: if 30-day average is below forecast, reduce forecast by 2–5% for next 5 days.
- Lagged response: forecast often peaks 1–3 days after true price peaks; shift forecast peak backward by 1–2 days.
- Avoid overfitting to recent history; if last 5 days are volatile, reduce forecast variance by 10–20%.
